items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: I heard Professor Dockett at this theatre.

ctx.x: You don't remember when you first heard it was at the New Orleans bands, I guess, and you just liked it from back to the…
Yeah, I heard New Orleans and I, when we moved to Chicago, I heard Professor Dockett at this theatre. The theatre, so that's… And I liked the sound of the instrument.
